clock_rule: Parse each EDGAR header ACCEPTANCE-DATETIME date and time. For an anchor, the earliest candidate feature use is the next actual Qlib US day after the acceptance calendar date at 09:46 America/New_York, never the accepted day. Compare it against both America/New_York and fixed UTC-05:00 readings of the SEC header clock and require at least 12 hours after the later UTC interpretation. This buffers daylight-label ambiguity and ordinary dissemination, but is not proof of exact first web receipt.
stop: Any source/NAS/provider identity, missing next trading day or 12-hour buffer failure stops. A three-anchor pass only defines a conservative candidate timing rule for separately audited 2011-2026 filings; it does not certify full coverage, semantic currency comparability, actual first-public dissemination or a Stage1 factor/account.
